{{Quote|I've already sworn to hunt down every pus-ridden Emperor lover on this planet...|Danla Zin|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Danla Zin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] member of the [[Balmorran resistance]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Her husband, [[Magar (Human)|Magar]] had stolen an Imperial uniforms and with some of his friends tried to infiltrate the Nebula Research Base in the [[Gorinth Canyon]]. Unfortunately for them, at the same time the base was being assaulted by the [[Voidhound]] and [[Corso Riggs]] who, upon seeing Imperials in uniform, opened fire and killed the men on the spot. After Danla Zin called Magar on the [[Holocomm/Legends|holocomm]], the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and Corso, in horror, recognized their terrible mistake. They approached her to express their regrets, but Danla Zin held no grudge for them, having already lost too much in the war against the Empire. With Corso Riggs's approval, she kicked the rude man [[Whitat]] out of the resistance.
